title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery State Storage Day Rates in the Redemption Expense Payment
content:
State storage rate schedule for the redemption expense payment under Repossession and Collateral Recovery. The state is the contract state recorded on the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts.

**Rule.** For the redemption expense payment, where the contract's state is GA, MN or WI, the storage day rate is 20.00; where it is IL, OH or PA, the storage day rate is 22.00; in any other state the storage day rate is the class storage fee per day.

| Contract state | Storage day rate for the redemption expense payment |
|---|---|
| GA, MN, WI | 20.00 |
| IL, OH, PA | 22.00 |
| any other state | the class storage fee per day |

*Illustration (hypothetical):* 10 chargeable days on a GA contract are charged at 20.00 a day; on an OH contract at 22.00 a day.
